name: easytable-mcp

tools.name: easytable_list_types
tools.description: List the bookable areas/types for a restaurant (e.g. "Boka Inne", "Boka baren"). Returns each area's type id for use in the other availability tools.

id.description: Restaurant id — the `id` in a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> link.

lang.description: Widget language code (e.g. en, se, da, de, fr). Defaults to en.

tools.name: easytable_list_dates
tools.description: List bookable dates for a restaurant area and party size. Each entry has an ISO date and whether it is available.

id.description: Restaurant id — the `id` in a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> link.

lang.description: Widget language code (e.g. en, se, da, de, fr). Defaults to en.

tools.name: easytable_list_times
tools.description: List available time slots for a restaurant area, date, and party size. Times are returned as HH:MM.

id.description: Restaurant id — the `id` in a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> link.

lang.description: Widget language code (e.g. en, se, da, de, fr). Defaults to en.

date.description: Date to check, ISO YYYY-MM-DD (from easytable_list_dates).

tools.name: easytable_find_bookings
tools.description: Look up a restaurant's existing bookings made with a given mobile number. Returns each booking's id (for easytable_cancel_booking) plus a summary.

id.description: Restaurant id — the `id` in a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> link.

lang.description: Widget language code (e.g. en, se, da, de, fr). Defaults to en.

mobile.description: Mobile number the booking was made with, in E.164 (e.g. +46701234567).

tools.name: easytable_cancel_booking
tools.description: Cancel an existing booking. Look up the booking id first with easytable_find_bookings (it needs the mobile the booking was made with). Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). The first call only looks the booking up (a read); it cancels nothing.

id.description: Restaurant id — the `id` in a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> link.

mobile.description: Mobile the booking was made with, E.164 (e.g. +46701234567).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

tools.name: easytable_create_booking
tools.description: Create a restaurant booking. Reads the Cloudflare Turnstile token from your signed-in booking-widget tab (via the bridge) and submits it with the reservation — so a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> tab must be open and loaded. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). The first call makes NO network call.

id.description: Restaurant id — the `id` in a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> link.

lang.description: Widget language code (en, se, da, …). Defaults to en.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

tools.name: easytable_modify_booking
tools.description: Modify an existing booking (date/time/party size/details). Like create, it reads the Turnstile token from your signed-in widget tab. Get the existing booking id from easytable_find_bookings. The change replaces the whole booking: email, comment and company are required — pass the booking's current values to keep them (ask the user if unknown), or '' to clear them; the newsletter opt-in is reset. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE). The first call makes NO network call.

id.description: Restaurant id — the `id` in a book.easytable.com/book/?id=<id> link.

email.description: Guest email. REQUIRED — the booking's current email, or '' to remove it (also drops the confirmation mail).

comment.description: Free-text note / special requests. REQUIRED — the booking's current comment (e.g. allergy notes), or '' to remove it.

company.description: Company name. REQUIRED — the booking's current company, or '' for none.

lang.description: Widget language code (en, se, da, …). Defaults to en.

existing.description: Id of the existing booking to modify (from easytable_find_bookings).

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

tools.name: easytable_healthcheck
tools.description: Round-trips a small public book.easytable.com URL (/robots.txt) through ContextMint Bridge (your signed-in browser tab) and returns diagnostics: the bridge's role (host/peer/null), port, version, the extension link (linked / pair pending / not attached / never answered), the elapsed round-trip time, and a plain-English hint distinguishing 'bridge never came up' from 'extension not connected' from 'this browser can't serve a capability' from 'real book.easytable.com-side problem'. Read-only, no auth required. Call this when a real tool fails and you want to know which hop broke.
